rows.grounds: fused form; locative absolute sense indicating absence of a specified mantra
compound accusative object to be employed

items.question: When no specific mantra is prescribed, should the name-mantra be used in every ritual context?
items.inference: Therefore the name-mantra is the universal substitute when no mantra is specified.
uncertainties: exact sense of anuktau remains uncertain
scope of sarvatra in ritual practice remains unclear
items.plain_english: When no mantra is specified, one should use the name-mantra everywhere.
